worldcombat.skill.return.summary: Deliver a full-power blow for your Trainer: a golden oath gathers at your feet, then a beam of gold charges the target for a single heavy hit. The deeper the friendship, the heavier the blow; it reads the same number as Frustration but in the opposite direction, one a single blow, one a flurry.
worldcombat.skill.return.use.0: One full-power blow when friendship is high
worldcombat.skill.return.use.1: Close in and shove the target off you
worldcombat.skill.return.use.2: Trusted form: charge straight through to reposition
worldcombat.skill.return.description.0: A landed hit deals about %1$s contact damage, once per target; a deeper bond makes the blow heavier. Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.return.description.1: Charge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block hit radius; a miss runs to the end of the charge, stopping early if the path is blocked.
worldcombat.skill.return.description.2: A landed hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the charge; the trusted form then carries you about %2$s blocks past it to reposition.
worldcombat.skill.return.devoted.on: Trusted form on: a heavier oath, a longer charge, and a carry past the target to reposition, at the cost of a longer preparation, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.return.devoted.off: Trusted form off (direct form): a shorter, quicker blow that stops on impact, with a shorter preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.return.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.return.preference.devo: On: a heavier, longer charge that carries you past the target to reposition, at the cost of a longer preparation, recovery and cooldown. Off: a shorter, quicker blow that stops on impact.
worldcombat.skill.return.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of charging. Larger values chase harder.
worldcombat.skill.return.preference.ai.b: When its friendship is at least this value the move becomes a primary melee option that outranks other attacks (and it is at its strongest then); raise it so only deeply bonded individuals prioritise it.
worldcombat.skill.return.preference.ai.f: On: raise priority further when the target is below about a third health, to finish it with this blow. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
worldcombat.skill.return.preference.ai.l: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to charge. Off: it only charges when the target is already in reach.
